info.title: Corpord demo booking and catalogue quality API
info.description: Additive specification. Legacy API remains in swagger.yaml; route/catalog search remains in routes.openapi.json. This MVP holds demo seats, stores saved names and audits explicit stop mappings. It does not sell tickets, process payments or infer real carrier inventory. All timestamps are RFC3339 UTC; money is integer RUB kopecks.

get.description: Read-only; does not create inventory. Demo trips use min(lazy capacity snapshot, current bus capacity). Real trips return unknown/null/bookable=false. Sold-out demo trips return seats=0 and bookable=false. Repeated stop pairs return409 ambiguous_segment. Availability is advisory; create rechecks under locks.

post.summary: Hold one demo seat on a section
post.description: One automatically chosen seat, maximum five active holds per owner across trips. Overlapping sections cannot reuse a seat; adjacent sections can. Expiry is at most600 seconds, capped at departure; trust expires_at. No sale/payment/ticket. Saved passenger ownership and fare are checked transactionally. Repeated-stop ambiguity returns409 ambiguous_segment. Other409 codes: sold_out, hold_limit, idempotency_conflict, trip_unavailable, inventory_unavailable. Replay returns200, including expired/cancelled snapshots, and never renews TTL.

post.summary: Explicitly map a stop to a selected city
post.description: Administrator role required. Transaction locks city before stop, checks optimistic version and schedule references, validates explicit timezone, then appends actor/before/after audit. No nearest-city inference, no source_snapshot overwrite.409 stale_version/stop_in_use/timezone_conflict;503 quality_timeout or quality_busy. Response contains the new version.

code.description: Stable module error code. Legacy auth/role/query middleware may omit this property.

passenger_name.description: Trimmed Unicode name. Server trims before validating 1–160 characters and rejects control characters.

status.description: Only held expires at database time; payment_committing and confirmed occupy their seat independently of the original hold TTL.

amount_minor.description: Server-calculated immutable section fare in RUB kopecks.

expires_at.description: Original held expiry: earlier of created_at+600 seconds and departure_time. Replays do not extend it; payment_committing/confirmed do not expire at this deadline.

cancelled_at.description: Set once for a cancellation of a live hold; null for expired or never-cancelled holds.

checkout_id.description: Existing checkout link; use checkout API actions rather than hold cancel when present.

checkout_enabled.description: Server capability for sandbox checkout creation. No provider call or per-row query.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset position; null when there is no next page.
